headerPolicy: Every copied or adapted source file starts with: Adapted from pingdotgg/t3code @ <commit>; Copyright (c) 2026 T3 Tools Inc. — MIT License; See third_party/licenses/t3code-MIT.txt; plus the Nexus changes. A file written from upstream behavior or design without any upstream code starts with: Inspired by pingdotgg/t3code @ <commit> (no code copied), names the upstream reference and is recorded with type "reference". One entry per upstream source of a Nexus file. Binary and license artifacts are recorded here by SHA-256 instead.
vendoringPolicy: Harvest, not a fork: modules are copied or adapted into the Nexus architecture (React 18, Nexus CSS tokens, zustand, async/await instead of Effect-TS). No Effect, Tailwind, Base UI or TanStack dependency is added; @pierre/trees was not added (Nexus rows instead). heic-to (LGPL-3.0) was deliberately not imported: HEIC/HEIF goes through /usr/bin/sips in Main.
